description: Whether one transaction on Base confirmed and what it did to a Mamo Account — deposits, withdrawals, compounding, claims, and Stocks openings, target changes, rebalances, in-kind exits and fees — with amounts. Needs the `txHash` the USER'S WALLET returned (this server never broadcasts; unmined is `pending`), or an EIP-5792 `callsId`, which the result explains.

callsId.description: The identifier a wallet returns from a batched send (EIP-5792). Provide this or `txHash`.

txHash.description: A transaction hash on Base, 0x-prefixed and 32 bytes. Provide this or `callsId`.

name: get_transaction_status
title: Check a Mamo transaction
